note: Live-session recording of the screen scenes (series/tools/rec). prepare/teardown run on the laptop, not recorded; commands are typed and run for real. Servers are started hidden by prepare (helper C:\lab\mgnet\svc.ps1) and their logs are shown with Get-Content/Select-String. Benchmarks and the load test must have the machine to themselves: plug in, power plan Best performance, nothing else running. Numbers on screen are the laptop's own. The BenchmarkDotNet host banner (CPU model, OS build) must be cropped; the prompt is neutral (PS>).
prepare: if (-not (Get-Command dotnet-counters -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)) { dotnet tool install -g dotnet-counters }

screens.name: sql-log
benchmarks
mask: BenchmarkDotNet host banner: CPU model, OS build, machine and user name (crop)

screens.name: loadtest
counters
steps: Two panes. Left: dotnet-counters monitor -n ProjectRequests.Perf.Api --counters ProjectRequests.Perf  (if the process is not found: dotnet-counters ps and --process-id)
Wait one second, then curl.exe -s -o NUL http://localhost:5209/api/summary again
Left pane: mglab.perf.requests.created ticks, mglab.perf.summary.computed ticks once after the write, not for the cached reads
